title: "Shiny Apps User Guide (retired)"

::: {.callout-important}
## Retired

The Scores and Species Shiny apps this guide walks through were retired in October 2026 when the
Atlas became the project's application; their URLs now redirect to the Atlas. The screenshots below
were captured from the last Shiny build and are kept as a record. For the current app see the
[Atlas user guide](../apps-guide.qmd).
:::

This guide walked through the two interactive Shiny applications — **Scores**
(`app.marinesensitivity.org/{ver}/scores/`) and **Species**
(`app.marinesensitivity.org/{ver}/species/`) — one control at a time. Each numbered step below mirrors
a step in that app's built-in **Take a Tour** (*About → Take a Tour* in either app), with the relevant
control highlighted on the screenshot.

For a feature-by-feature reference instead, see the
[Scores](scores.qmd) and [Species](species.qmd) pages.

::: callout-tip
## How this guide was generated

The steps, captions, and highlighted screenshots were generated directly from
the apps' in-app tours (the `Conductor$new()$step(...)` chains in each
`app.R`) by `libs/apps-guide-regenerate.R`, which wrote
`figures/apps-guide/steps.json`. The apps are retired and unreachable, so that
script can no longer run and this page is frozen at the last capture.
:::

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
librarian::shelf(jsonlite, here, quiet = TRUE)

# frozen: the Shiny apps are retired, so there is no staleness check
manifest <- here::here("figures", "apps-guide", "steps.json")
steps    <- if (file.exists(manifest)) jsonlite::read_json(manifest) else list()
```

```{r}
#| label: guide
#| output: asis
if (length(steps) == 0) {
  cat(
    "::: callout-warning\n",
    "`figures/apps-guide/steps.json` is missing; it was generated by ",
    "`libs/apps-guide-regenerate.R` from the Shiny apps, which are retired, ",
    "so this page cannot be regenerated.\n",
    ":::\n", sep = "")
} else {
  for (app in unique(vapply(steps, `[[`, "", "app"))) {
    cat(sprintf("\n## %s app\n\n", app))
    for (s in Filter(function(x) x$app == app, steps)) {
      cat(sprintf("\n### %d. %s\n\n", s$n, s$title))
      cat(s$text, "\n\n")
      cat(sprintf(
        "![%s](%s){#fig-%s-%02d fig-alt=\"%s\"}\n\n",
        s$title, s$image, s$app_key, s$n, gsub('"', "'", s$text)))
    }
  }
}
```
